name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix + animation domain (consistent with the sibling tables in anitab.c, all data_fd2_animation_*) + descriptor earthquake_screen_shake_params_table that reflects both purpose (earthquake/di-zhen spell full-screen shake parameters) and the array/table data type. No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix equal to its own or any data address). No domain ID to preserve.
purpose: Earthquake (di zhen) spell full-screen-shake parameter table: per-frame X/Y screen-shake displacement and magnification for the 3 slow-shake frames of fd2_cast_earthquake_spell_with_screen_shake.
logic_summary: 9 signed int32 stored as three parallel 3-entry sets keyed by slow-shake frame i (0..2): X-offset = entries[0..2] {128,0,-128}; Y-offset = entries[3..5] {128,0,128}; scale = entries[6..8] {131,128,125}. The sole reader copies all 9 dwords onto the stack as three MOVSD x3 blocks (sources 0x52096 / 0x520a2 / 0x520ae) and, per frame i, passes scale[i] as fd2_blit_scaled_tile_map_view arg3 (0x2167e), adds X-offset[i] into arg1 X-screen (0x216a4) and Y-offset[i] into arg2 Y-screen (0x216cb). The Layer-2 consumer src/spell/spellcin.c indexes the global directly as shake_params[i] / [i+3] / [i+6] -- equivalent.
element_semantics: Signed 32-bit per element. [0..2]=per-frame X-offset {128,0,-128}; [3..5]=per-frame Y-offset {128,0,128}; [6..8]=per-frame scale/magnification {131,128,125}. The -128 (entry[2], 0xFFFFFF80) proves SIGNED int32; every access is a 4-byte dword load/move.
notes: Verified live: read_memory @0x52096 (36B) = {128,0,-128,128,0,128,131,128,125} matching src exactly; xrefs_to = only fd2_cast_earthquake_spell_with_screen_shake (READ@0x21562 + DATA@0x2155d), zero writers -> const correct. Disassembly @0x21548 confirms every cited address (0x2155d/0x21569/0x21575 MOVSD x3 from 0x52096/0x520a2/0x520ae; 0x2167e scale->arg3; 0x216a4 X->arg1; 0x216cb Y->arg2) and the signed dword access pattern, so the src comment (lines 262-298) is accurate, ASCII, and precise -> kept unchanged (no Edit to anitab.c). Ghidra data plate was empty (null) -> created concise plate reflecting the src conclusion via run_script_inline PLATE_COMMENT (verified set). globals.h:445 declaration already matches (const int32[9], 0x52096).
